## ReferenceCountedResourceAccessRelease_005116a3 — Reference-counted resource release

**Summary:** Releases a reference to a tracked resource via callback; validates access against resource limit and tracks concurrent reference count.

**Frame-path:** NOT_FOUND  
**Call frequency:** UNKNOWN (no static path from tick root)

**Called by:** (none static — top-level or indirect-only)

**Struct fields accessed:**

| Base | Offset | R/W | Init (literal → value) | Purpose |
|------|--------|-----|------------------------|---------|
| obj | 0x8 | R | — | release callback function pointer |
| obj | 0x68 | R | — | resource limit / max valid index |
| obj | 0x6C | R | — | concurrent reference count |
| this | 0x0 | R | — | pointer to resource tracking structure |

**Globals referenced:**

| Address | Name | R/W | Role |
|---------|------|-----|------|

**Functions called:**

| Address | Name | Purpose |
|---------|------|---------|

**Guard conditions (deterministic — field vs literal):**

| Base | Offset | Test | Value | Field / meaning |
|------|--------|------|-------|-----------------|
| obj | 0x68 | >= | 3 | resource limit check |

**Guard interpretation:** When a2 < 0 (unconditional release path), if obj->0x68 >= 3 the release callback always fires regardless of obj->0x6C; if obj->0x68 < 3, the callback fires only when obj->0x6C == 0 (no current references). When a2 >= 0 (indexed release path), callback fires only if a2 < obj->0x68. If the callback does not fire, only the reference count at obj->0x6C is incremented.
